text:
invoice-bot: New vendor invoice from Meridian AI: INV-MRD-210 for $3,850. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/INV-MRD-210. Vendor references no PO. Extracted GL: 4120.

hana_fin: Invoice breakdown shows model tuning services $3,000 and travel reimbursement $850. Travel should have been on a corporate card. No PO on file for tuning.

marc_proc: Procurement didn't issue a PO. This was an ad-hoc task approved by Eng lead verbally. We need either a post-facto PO or documented approval to pay.

diane_ap: AP requires either PO or written approval from budget owner. Due date in 5 days.

owen_eng: I approved the work via Slack DM with the vendor. I'm happy to sign a quick approval note. Is that sufficient?

hana_fin: Slack DM approval is acceptable if attached and the manager signs off. Can you post the approval text here and confirm cost center?

owen_eng: "I approve Meridian AI tuning work up to $3,000 on CC ENG-ML." Happy to confirm.

marc_proc: I'll create a retrospective PO PO-10077 for $3,000 pending Owen's sign-off and Hana's finance OK. That will let vendor get paid cleanly. Travel $850 should be reversed and vendor requested to credit.

vendor-bot: Meridian reply: "We can accept PO-10077 and issue a credit for travel if you send PO number to billing@meridian.ai."

hana_fin: Okay I'll attach Owen's sign-off and create AP ticket AP-5120. Marc, please queue PO-10077; expedite if possible. If PO isn't live in 24h we'll do approval override and attach manager note.

diane_ap: Noted. I'll hold payment until PO live or override approved.

marc_proc: PR-998 opened for PO-10077 with expedited routing. ETA 3 hours. Will update when PO is created.

hana_fin: Thanks all. Closing loop once PO/credit received.
